title: OIDC Token Exchange Aborted Due to Expired RSA Signing Key ID (kid)
trap_cluster: TRAP-AUTH-50X: Sibling OAuth/OIDC Handshake Codes
symptom: Enterprise users attempting single sign-on through the AegisIAM Gateway are redirected back to the login screen immediately after submitting valid credentials. Gateway trace logs record E_AUTH_501 during the authorization_code token exchange step because the upstream identity provider rotated its JWKS public keys and the gateway cache still references the retired key identifier.
resolution: Purge the in-memory JWKS key cache on the AegisIAM cluster by running `aegis-ctl jwks flush --all-nodes` and reduce `jwks_cache_ttl_seconds` from 86400 to 900 in `/etc/aegis/oidc.yaml` so key rollover events propagate automatically.

title: OIDC Token Exchange Rejected by Audience Claim (aud) Mismatch
trap_cluster: TRAP-AUTH-50X: Sibling OAuth/OIDC Handshake Codes
symptom: Single sign-on sessions fail right after the identity provider callback returns to AegisIAM Gateway. The authentication worker emits E_AUTH_503 when inspecting the returned ID token payload because the `aud` claim contains the staging client UUID instead of the production relying-party identifier.
resolution: Open the relying-party registration in the AegisIAM console, align the `client_id` and `expected_audience` fields with the production application URI, and redeploy the OIDC relying-party manifest.

title: PKCE Code Verifier SHA-256 Digest Failure on Mobile SSO Callback
trap_cluster: TRAP-AUTH-50X: Sibling OAuth/OIDC Handshake Codes
symptom: OAuth 2.0 login flows initiated from native iOS and Android clients terminate at the token endpoint with E_AUTH_509. The gateway rejects the request because the `code_verifier` string was URL-encoded twice by the mobile HTTP interceptor, causing the S256 hash comparison against `code_challenge` to fail.
resolution: Disable automatic percent-encoding on the `code_verifier` form parameter in the mobile SDK network layer, or upgrade the client library to `aegis-mobile-sdk >= 3.1.4` which transmits raw RFC 7636 Base64URL characters without double escaping.

title: Deep Packet TLS Inspection Drops Downstream Sessions Missing Intermediate CA
trap_cluster: TRAP-SSL-10X: Sibling TLS Handshake & Certificate Codes
symptom: Outbound HTTPS connections routed through NetCore EdgeProxy terminate during the ServerHello phase with ERR_SSL_102. The appliance cannot complete chain verification for external SaaS hosts whose servers omit the cross-signed intermediate certificate from the TLS handshake.
resolution: Enable AIA (Authority Information Access) intermediate certificate fetching in the proxy profile via `set ssl-inspection aia-fetch enable`, then reload the trusted CA bundle with `netcore-adm cert reload`.

title: Mutual TLS Client Certificate Rejected Due to OCSP Stapling Timeout
trap_cluster: TRAP-SSL-10X: Sibling TLS Handshake & Certificate Codes
symptom: Partner API webhooks authenticating via mutual TLS (mTLS) to NetCore EdgeProxy are dropped after a 5-second pause with ERR_SSL_108. Firewall egress rules on the DMZ VLAN block the appliance from reaching the external OCSP responder URL embedded in the client certificate.
resolution: Permit outbound TCP port 80/443 traffic from the EdgeProxy management interface to the CA's OCSP responder subnet, or enable `ocsp_soft_fail_fallback` when crl-distribution caching is active on the appliance.

title: TLS 1.3 Post-Handshake KeyUpdate Frame Triggers Cipher Suite Alert
trap_cluster: TRAP-SSL-10X: Sibling TLS Handshake & Certificate Codes
symptom: Long-lived gRPC streams passing through NetCore EdgeProxy sever abruptly after transferring roughly 1 GB of payload data, logging ERR_SSL_109. The hardware crypto offload card mishandles TLS 1.3 KeyUpdate messages when ChaCha20-Poly1305 is negotiated.
resolution: Prioritize `TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384` ahead of `TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256` in the ingress cipher policy, or disable hardware crypto offload for TLS 1.3 rekeying via `sysctl net.nitro.rekey_hw=0`.

title: BGP Hold-Timer Expiration Under High Route-Reflector Churn on Router-X1 v2.4.1
trap_cluster: TRAP-ROUTER-FW: Router-X1 v2.4.x Point-Release Regressions
symptom: After upgrading core border gateways to Router-X1 v2.4.1, eBGP peering sessions flap every 90 seconds whenever full internet routing tables are refreshed. A single-threaded mutex in the v2.4.1 RIB scanner starves keepalive packet scheduling while sorting prefix updates.
resolution: Apply hotfix package `rx1-routing-patch-241b.pkg` or enable asynchronous keepalive offloading with `router bgp keepalive-thread dedicated` in global configuration mode.

title: PPPoE WAN Sub-Interface Silent MTU Blackhole on Router-X1 v2.4.4
trap_cluster: TRAP-ROUTER-FW: Router-X1 v2.4.x Point-Release Regressions
symptom: Branch offices running Router-X1 v2.4.4 over fiber PPPoE uplinks can ping external IP addresses normally, but TLS handshakes and large HTTP responses stall indefinitely. Firmware v2.4.4 fails to subtract the 8-byte PPPoE encapsulation header when computing TCP MSS clamping.
resolution: Manually clamp the TCP Maximum Segment Size on the dialer interface by configuring `interface pppoe0 ip tcp adjust-mss 1452` until upgrading past v2.4.4.

title: OSPFv3 IPv6 Link-Local Neighbor Stuck in EXSTART State on Router-X1 v2.4.9
trap_cluster: TRAP-ROUTER-FW: Router-X1 v2.4.x Point-Release Regressions
symptom: Dual-stack core links running Router-X1 v2.4.9 fail to complete OSPFv3 adjacency formation, remaining permanently trapped in the EXSTART/EXCHANGE state. Build v2.4.9 introduces a regression in 802.1Q VLAN tag stripping on IPv6 Database Description (DBD) multicast frames.

title: 802.3bt PoE++ Class 6 Power Denial After Warm Reboot on OmniSwitch-48P v5.1.2
trap_cluster: TRAP-SWITCH-FW: OmniSwitch-48P v5.1.x Firmware Traps
symptom: Wi-Fi 6E access points and PTZ cameras connected to OmniSwitch-48P v5.1.2 fail to power up following a warm software reload, logging SW_POE_212. The microcontroller power budget table retains stale pre-reboot wattage allocations and refuses Class 6 LLDP power requests.
resolution: Reset the PoE controller bank without dropping switching traffic via `poe controller reset slot 1`, and enable `lldp med-power-negotiation strict` per port.

title: LACP Port-Channel Split-Brain During Fast-Timer Failover on OmniSwitch-48P v5.1.8
trap_cluster: TRAP-SWITCH-FW: OmniSwitch-48P v5.1.x Firmware Traps
symptom: Uplink aggregation groups on OmniSwitch-48P v5.1.8 drop both member links simultaneously with SW_LACP_218 when 1-second fast LACP PDU intervals are enabled alongside spanning-tree portfast trunking.
resolution: Switch the LACP periodic timer from `fast` (1s) to `normal` (30s) on the aggregate interface via `lacp timeout long`, or install ASIC microcode patch `os48p-518-lacp.bin`.

title: Write-Ahead Log (WAL) Checkpoint Fsync Stall on ZFS VolBlockSize Mismatch
trap_cluster: TRAP-DB-LOCK: Sibling Database Lock & Consensus Codes
symptom: High-throughput OLTP clusters running ChronosDB v6.3.0 freeze all incoming INSERT and UPDATE statements every 15 minutes with DB_LOCK_801. Background checkpoint workers block on `fdatasync` because the underlying ZFS dataset uses a 128 KB recordsize while ChronosDB writes 8 KB pages, causing severe read-modify-write amplification.
resolution: Align the storage dataset block size to the database page geometry (`zfs set recordsize=8k tank/chronos`) and set `wal_writer_delay_ms = 20` in `chronos.conf`.

title: Distributed Foreign-Key Gap Lock Deadlock Across Partitioned Shards
trap_cluster: TRAP-DB-LOCK: Sibling Database Lock & Consensus Codes
symptom: Batch upsert jobs executing under SERIALIZABLE isolation abort with DB_LOCK_804 when two worker threads concurrently insert child rows referencing the same parent composite key across hash-partitioned shards.
resolution: Downgrade batch ingestion sessions to `READ COMMITTED` isolation or sort input rows deterministically by `(tenant_id, parent_id)` prior to beginning the multi-shard transaction.

title: Raft Quorum Lease Expiration Causes Read-Only Split-Brain Fencing
trap_cluster: TRAP-DB-LOCK: Sibling Database Lock & Consensus Codes
symptom: Primary storage nodes demote themselves to read-only followers and reject client writes with DB_LOCK_809 during cross-AZ network jitter. The Raft leader lease timer (`500ms`) expires before heartbeat acknowledgments return from the witness node in the third availability zone.
resolution: Increase `raft_leader_lease_ms` to `1500` and `raft_election_timeout_ms` to `4500` in the cluster consensus configuration, and verify NTP clock drift across nodes is below 10ms.

title: Kubelet Ephemeral Storage Inode Exhaustion Triggers Pod Eviction Manager

resolution: Prune exited container layers and orphaned overlayfs directories via `crictl rmi --prune`, and enforce `resources.limits.ephemeral-storage` on jobs generating high small-file counts.

title: PostgreSQL Transaction ID (XID) Wraparound Protection Forces Emergency Vacuum Mode

title: Acoustic Coil Whine From MLCC Piezoelectric Resonance Under C-State Residency
